title: The terms of the duel
intro: Hector sets out the terms: the winner strips the loser’s armour but returns the body. The Greeks fall silent, and Menelaus arms himself.

notes.text: αἱρέω, take / kill: 3sg 2aor subj, future-more-vivid with κεν; κεῖνος = ἐκεῖνος, that man.
ταναήκης, long-edged: dat sg; χαλκός, bronze, i.e. the spear.
τεύχεα, arms (pl of τεῦχος); συλάω, strip: aor ptc; φέρω: 3sg imperative.
δίδωμι, give: aor inf, epic -μεναι, used as imperative; οἴκαδε, homeward; πάλιν, back.
λαγχάνω, obtain a share of + gen: 3pl reduplicated 2aor subj, purpose after ὄφρα; θανόντα, aor ptc acc, “me dead.”
ἄλοχος, wife: nom pl; the Trojans and their wives will give the funeral rites.

notes.lemma: εἰ δέ κ᾽ ἐγὼ τὸν ἕλω
notes.text: αἱρέω: 1sg aor subj; second condition, set against the first.
δίδωμι, give: 3sg aor subj; εὖχος, glory / boast of victory.
συλάω aor ptc, as in 78; φέρω, carry: 1sg fut οἴσω; προτί = πρός, to.
κρεμάννυμι, hang up: 1sg fut, epic uncontracted; νηός, temple: acc νηόν.
ἕκατος, far-shooting: gen sg, epithet of Apollo.
νέκυς, corpse; ἐΰσσελμος, well-benched: acc pl fem, of the ships.
ἀποδίδωμι, give back: 1sg fut.
ταρχύω, bury with full rites: 3pl aor subj; ἑ, him, enclitic acc.
κομάω, wear long hair: pres ptc nom pl, epic; κάρη, acc of respect; stock epithet “long-haired.”
σῆμα, mound / marker; χέω, pour / heap up: 3pl aor subj; οἱ, for him.
πλατύς, broad: dat sg; Ἑλλήσποντος, Hellespont.
εἶπον: 3sg aor subj, -σι ending, indefinite “someone will say”; ὀψίγονος, born later: gen pl.
πολυκλήϊς, with many oarlocks / benches: dat sg; πλέω, sail: pres ptc.
οἶνοψ, wine-dark: acc sg with πόντον.
καταθνῄσκω, die: perf ptc gen sg, epic -ηῶτος; σῆμα, mound of a man long dead.
ἀριστεύω, be the best, fight bravely: pres ptc acc; κατακτείνω, kill: 3sg 2aor.
ἐρέω, will say: 3sg fut; ὄλλυμι, perish: 3sg fut mid; κλέος, glory.
ἀκήν, silent; γίγνομαι: 3pl 2aor; σιωπῇ, in silence, dat.
αἰδέομαι, feel shame: 3pl aor pass, epic form.
ἀναίνομαι, refuse: aor inf; δείδω, fear: 3pl aor; ὑποδέχομαι, accept / undertake: aor inf.
ὀψέ, late; ἀνίστημι, stand up: mid 3sg impf; μετεῖπον, speak among: 3sg aor.
νεῖκος, reproach: dat sg; ὀνειδίζω, revile: pres ptc.
στεναχίζω, groan: 3sg impf mid.
ἀπειλητήρ, boaster: voc pl; Ἀχαιΐς, Achaean woman: pl, “Achaean women, no longer Achaean men.”
λώβη, disgrace; ἔσσεται = ἔσται; αἰνόθεν αἰνῶς, “dreadfully dreadful.”
ἀντίος, facing; εἶμι, go: 3sg, with future sense, after εἰ μή.
γίγνομαι, become: 2pl aor opt, wish; “may you all turn to water and earth.”
ἧμαι, sit: ptc; αὖθι, right there; ἀκήριος, spiritless; ἀκλεές adv, inglorious; αὔτως, just so.
τῷδε, against this man; θωρήσσομαι, arm myself: 1sg fut; ὕπερθε, above.
πεῖραρ, end / cord: nom pl; ἔχομαι, be held: 3pl pres mid; “the ends of victory lie with the gods.”
φωνέω, speak: aor ptc; καταδύομαι, put on: 3sg aor mid, epic -σετο.
